summary_bullets: Stall recovery now files first-detection bugs with a parser-compatible issue input file.
Recovery issue metadata is documented for create and dedup paths so terminal comments can target the right issue.
Stall-step title sanitization now preserves documented production tokens while rejecting injected suffixes.
commit_message:
Fix stall recovery issue input filing

Route Step 18a first-detection filing through the heading-bearing stall-recovery issue input file and document canonical issue key normalization for create and dedup paths. Tighten stall-step title sanitization to full-token matches while preserving documented production stall tokens. Add parser and structure regressions for the issue-input wiring and unsafe step values.
